svg.title: Lensed accretion disk — crisp photoreal vector reconstruction
svg.desc: A dense vector reconstruction of the supplied black-hole image using smooth quadratic vector contours, continuous gradient illumination, independently fitted color fields, and fine flow-aligned strokes. This SVG contains no embedded or linked raster images. Simplified variant lite3 retaining approximately 28% of the fine filament strokes to reduce render cost. Further simplified variant lite6 derived from lite3, retaining approximately 18% of lite3 fine filament strokes. Aggressive simplification lite9, retaining 30 fine filament strokes. Ultra-simplified lite12, retaining 0 fine filament strokes.
